note: Printed public numbers only. LPSC 2023 1266: ~5 W overnight electronics dissipation; ~19 kg night battery; cube-in-cube; solar recharge by day; 4.5 months including nights. Wh not printed. witness_note: none flown for FSS. CP-12 terminated Jul 2026. Re-flight UNVERIFIED. Do not join LuSEE-Lite on the same terminated task order.
killer_store_open: printed ~5 W overnight electronics × 354 h Cataldo/Mason = 1770 Wh nameplate. Store Wh OPEN (~19 kg printed; kg ≠ Wh; chemistry not printed). Reserve OPEN. Lives iff store > 1770 Wh at nameplate. Do not pick Wh from 19 kg.
thermal_hold_md: No printed FSS night hold T_box. LPSC 1266: cube-in-cube, vectran cables, spacerless MLI, thermal switch, mini loop heat pipe, radiator; heating primarily ~5 W electronics dissipation through the night. LPSC 2354: inner cube houses seismometers, battery, avionics; titanium tube supports named, alloy OPEN. JPL: survive frigid nights / searing days — no kelvin. T_env OPEN: Schrödinger Basin is the printed site, not a printed sink temperature. Do not mix polar PSR 23 K or PALETTE toolbox KPP.
alloy_md: Vectran tension cables named (LPSC 1266). Titanium tube supports named (LPSC 2354). Alloys OPEN. No NIST map. Fourier not run.
honesty_md: ~5 W and ~19 kg are printed with tildes. Wh not printed. SOC/efficiency not printed — reserve OPEN. 354 h is Cataldo/Mason darkness, not a Schrödinger site night. 4.5 months / 4½ months is lifetime including nights, not H_night. ICES PALETTE not mixed (no FSS-specific W/Wh opened). CP-12 terminated Jul 2026; JPL launch 2027 still listed; re-flight UNVERIFIED.
